scope: Original bounded future ownership/lifecycle requirements derived from current source. No implementation, model change, provider/API availability claim, new tests, hardware access or admission.

current_source_facts.fact: Per-object zero/init and exact requester checks; explicit synthetic RID0x100/SID0..15. Caller holds stable policy arrays/storage/workspace and excludes aliases. Tables are copied from validated scratch into two ordinary16K pages. No global requester/SID registry, allocation, unmap, hardware publication or invalidation exists.

Per-object vector ownership only; exact fake profile address0xfffff000, vectors0..7,AIC704. close requires masked allocated bits and no pending fake event; no handler detach/drain/free. ready errors leave source unchanged and are not sticky.

Config-window write at0x80 already precedes shared-ring discovery. dirty/pending set before write callback; I/O and verify errors latch fault; successful operation clears pending but does not establish physical drain. Caller owns serialized session/accessor; no reentry or reset recovery.

Descriptor address/depth serialization occurs in configure before submit. Submit copies bytes, publishes producer then rings doorbell. Partial/error state may be dirty/faulted/inflight; success clears inflight but retains descriptor/buffer. Consumer equality closes logically only. Buffer CPU pointer and fake_bus_label are independently supplied; there is no physical backing identity proof.

Static F.owner provides test-level admission and duplicate-prepare rejection. Synthetic PA checked separately from F.buffer. fresh resets ordinary RAM between episodes. The test is not a production resource manager.

Previous independent probes show separate map/source objects can claim the same requester/vector resources. Central exclusivity is therefore a concrete missing contract, not supplied by model-local checks.

minimal_next_source_artifact.proposal: Separate original bounded private lifecycle core: one platform-owned registry plus stable endpoint lease and append-only exposure/cleanup ledger. Preserve all fake model implementations/freezes. First deliverable supports private claim, backing validation, refusal/quarantine and never-exposed retirement only; it must not call MMIO or report a real endpoint ACTIVE.
minimal_next_source_artifact.registry_scope: Exactly one registry owned by the platform provider for the selected APCIE/DART/interrupt domain; clients must not instantiate a new registry to bypass conflicts. Initial bound one endpoint on port0/RID0x100, one explicitly justified SID, one subset of8 vectors, one H2D ring. Bounds are implementation policy, not additional discovered hardware facts.
resource_keys: Platform/domain identity plus port and RID; reject duplicate RID even if requested SID differs.
DART instance plus SID/TTBR slot; reject aliasing active or quarantined claim.
Interrupt-controller identity plus absolute vector set/AIC range; reject intersecting claims, not merely duplicate source objects.
CPU view, physical span and device IOVA intervals for table and data backing; distinct logical keys cannot authorize overlapping resources.
minimal_next_source_artifact.token_rules: Private stable-address lease record with registry identity, slot identity and nonzero monotonically increasing64-bit generation; overflow exhausts permanently. Every operation compares the live record, state and exact generation. Stale/copied tokens cannot create an independent owner. This is trusted in-kernel component discipline, not protection against arbitrary memory corruption.
minimal_next_source_artifact.serialization: All lifecycle/model/provider operations share one control serialization domain. Reject reentry; reserve claims before callbacks; callbacks receive immutable operation identity. Future ISR/deferred paths need a separate reference/notification discipline and explicit detach/join before release; do not block or free in interrupt context.
minimal_next_source_artifact.bounded_storage: Initially two16K table allocations and one16K data allocation containing one ring <=16 items *64 bytes, one borrowed-or-owned immutable policy snapshot bounded by frozen codec capacities. Large scratch lives in stable provider-owned storage, not kernel stack. Limits may expand only in separately reviewed source.
minimal_next_source_artifact.backing_contract: A real provider must return typed TABLE or DATA handles carrying allocation identity/generation, prepared state, CPU view+length and physically verified segment span. Check full16K spans and conservative36-bit PA bounds, overflow, alignment, RAM/reservation membership, CPU and PA disjointness before zero/copy. Derive IOVA mapping and ring descriptor from the same DATA handle+offset; never accept unrelated pointer and bus label. No inherited firmware roots, foreign buffers or table/data reinterpretation.
minimal_next_source_artifact.permissions: Only explicit device READ/WRITE subsets supported by the frozen codec; deny zero/unknown/execute. Initial H2D ring requires device READ only. Exclude MSI page and all table/reserved spans from data mappings. Numeric validation is required but cannot authenticate actual RID/SID ownership or MSI routing.
proposed_operations_not_implemented: claim_private(registry, request) -> checked lease or unchanged failure
attach_private_backing(lease, provider_handles) -> validated private binding; no device exposure
record_effect_begin(lease, operation_id, resource_mask, effect_kind) before any future backend callback
record_effect_result(lease, same operation_id, result) without clearing historical exposure
quarantine(lease, original_error, attempted_effects) -> sticky retained state
request_retire(lease) -> refuse new submissions; never itself declares drain
retire_never_exposed(lease) -> release only exact completed private provider pairs; no exposure/drain boolean supplied by caller
minimal_next_source_artifact.excluded_initial_APIs: No hardware activation/publication, drain-ack boolean, unmap-after-close, force-reset, force-release, owner memset/reinit, fake-to-real cast or MMIO accessor escape.

state_requirements.entry: Atomic conflict-free lease reservation before allocation/callbacks.
state_requirements.allowed: Attach and validate private resources. On pre-exposure failure release only known-private resources with successful provider completion; any uncertainty quarantines.

state_requirements.entry: All typed handles live, stable, disjoint and codec validation passes under common serialization.
state_requirements.allowed: Private validation or never-exposed retirement. Does not imply reachability, readiness or hardware authority.

state_requirements.entry: Future separately admitted real provider establishes actual domain/RID/SID ownership, device reachability, mapping visibility/invalidation, interrupt installation and firmware protocol state.
state_requirements.allowed: Unavailable in initial private core; fake status and numeric/source facts cannot enter it.

state_requirements.entry: Uncertain provider prepare/complete, attempted publication with error, identity/link loss during exposed lifetime, readback mismatch, or sticky submodule failure.
state_requirements.allowed: Preserve first failure and all ownership/backing/event references; reject new work/retry/reuse. No physical-release transition in initial implementation.

state_requirements.entry: Stop accepting new requests under serialization.
state_requirements.allowed: Retain claims while real provider separately establishes no new submissions, device DMA drain, IRQ mask+detach+handler/deferred-work join, and mapping invalidation completion. Ordering depends on real hardware contracts and cannot be invented from fake close.

state_requirements.entry: For private never-exposed lifetime: every acquired prepare has a successful complete/release. For any exposed lifetime: all real drain/detach/unmap/invalidation and provider completion obligations independently discharged.
state_requirements.allowed: Invalidate lease generation before releasing registry claims. No reuse on uncertain teardown. Exposed retirement remains blocked without real provider.

failure_and_publication_rules: Treat any endpoint write attempt as possible device-side mutation before invoking callback; config window and descriptor configuration count even if no producer/doorbell was attempted.
Keep monotonic ever_exposed/effect_attempted resource masks separate from transient pending_writes/inflight/completed. A successful readback or index equality cannot erase prior exposure.
Do not infer NOT_APPLIED from a failed callback. Default result is UNKNOWN after attempted effect; quarantine regardless of whether the fake fault applies the write.

Wrapper records exact module/status/stage and normalizes I/O/verify/ownership-loss failures to sticky lifecycle quarantine. Existing IRQ nonsticky errors must not permit wrapper retry; predecessor errors remain visible.
Pure preflight argument/range refusals, FULL/EMPTY and orderly BUSY need not poison a still-valid state when no operation effect began. BUSY during retirement retains resources; it is not completion.

Prepare success and complete success are independently tracked per handle; uncertain partial prepare or completion retains the handle and claims. No loop retrying unknown complete and no owner-wide reset.
Time budget expiry, link loss or PHY reset is not proof of stopped DMA/interrupts. In particular shared PHY/PMGR reset is neither available nor an allowed cleanup shortcut.
required_next_source_tests_not_run: Two clients contend for same registry RID with different SID; duplicate SID and overlapping vector ranges; quarantined claims remain unavailable.
Forged/stale/copy token, wrong registry, generation wrap, reentry, changed provider handle/view/length, and callbacks reporting wrong operation identity refuse before writes.
CPU aliases, PA aliases, table/data overlap, partial backing,36-bit overflow, MSI-page overlap, ring offset/capacity overflow and changed policy detected before zero/copy.
Failure before and after every provider acquisition/preparation; exact cleanup pair accounting; uncertain prepare/complete quarantines without reuse.
Exposure ledger includes config/descriptor/index/bell attempts; applied-but-error and no-apply-but-error both quarantine; success never clears historical exposure.
Logical consumer equality, fake IRQ empty, fake close, timeout or arbitrary caller boolean cannot satisfy physical retirement; no real ACTIVE transition in private-only build.

Host sanitizers and mutation tests target registry checks and ledger ordering. Actual pinned SDK compilation must be separately recorded before any production integration; host success alone is not kernel/provider evidence.
blocking_real_provider_facts: Current saved observation is PHY_NOT_READY; port/endpoint admission remains STOP. No permission to enable shared PHY/PMGR writes or retry hardware.
Actual RID-to-SID/domain ownership and coordination with inherited platform users is not established by explicit fake SID3 or ADT vector metadata.
Actual prepared physical backing, mapping installation, cache visibility, DART invalidation completion and safe teardown providers are absent from these four models.
Actual T8103 MSI setup/acknowledgement, ISR/deferred-work synchronization and device DMA drain are not implemented; no MSI register layout is inferred.
Actual chip/core/firmware identity, calibrated metadata, firmware handoff, ring item protocol and mailbox/ring phase coexistence remain separate unresolved contracts.
